0022600223.text: The Brooklyn Nets (2-8, 13th in the East) visit the New Orleans Pelicans (4-5, 11th in the West) in the Nets' 11th game of the season, and Brooklyn is 1-5 on the road and has lost its last two games. Egor Demin (leg bruise) and Mikel Brown Jr. (rest) are out for the Nets, and Brown Jr. is averaging 12.9 points and 23.2 minutes per game this season. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and they split their 2025-26 series 1-1, with Brooklyn's most recent meeting a 116-113 loss in New Orleans on January 14, 2026.
